frozen_pass_rule: A task is PASSED for an arm IFF the independent held-out judge tags it FAITHFUL AND the positive-real-outcome floor check exits 0 AND the held-out anti-overfit check exits 0 (verify.py:213-215 both-must-pass spine). Run ONCE per (arm,task), NO retry-to-pass for the headline. Bounded small-k re-run ONLY on margin tasks for consistency reporting, NEVER to flip a fail to a pass.

The floor check exit-0 is grounded by the tail message 'emails.txt holds exactly the real extracted addresses', which asserts content-level correctness rather than mere file presence — the checker validated the extracted addresses match the actual source data. The held-out anti-overfit check also exits 0 with tail 'HELDOUT-PASS: re-extracted held-out addresses', which rules out the hardcoded-literal and vacuous-extraction failure modes by demonstrating the arm's extraction logic generalised to addresses not in the original example set; a script that merely echoed known values would have failed the held-out probe.

The floor check (`check_pb3.py` exit 0) guarantees only that a `unique.txt` file existed at check time whose contents matched the expected first-seen deduplication of the specific fixture `words.txt` — it does not verify that a reusable command or script was produced, only that the output file satisfies the example case. The floor check exit code 0 is accompanied by an explicit message 'the REAL settings.json was actually mutated in the asserted direction', ruling out proxy/presence-test and named-target-untouched failure modes — the check verified the actual file on disk changed. The held-out anti-overfit check (also exit 0) adds 'genuine value-preserving rename, not a blind overfit rewrite', ruling out the hardcoded-literal and overfit failure modes and confirming the value was kept intact; together the two orthogonal checks cover the user's full stated requirement (key renamed, value preserved, nothing else changed).

The floor check (check_pb5.py exit 0) explicitly reports 'FLOOR-PASS: wc_lines really counts the real file's lines', meaning the script verified actual line-count correctness against a real file — not mere executable presence or a hardcoded literal match — and the held-out anti-overfit check also exited 0 ('HELDOUT-PASS: wc_lines counted a held-out file'), confirming the program generalizes to an independently-constructed test file the arm could not have been overfit to; both independent passes together constitute genuine verification that the line-counting behavior the user requested was delivered into the world.

The floor check (`check_pb6.py`, exit 0) directly ran the target `avg.py` and asserted it now prints the correct average, and the held-out anti-overfit check (exit 0) independently confirmed the fix recomputes on a held-out range rather than emitting a hardcoded literal — ruling out the two most common hollow-pass failure modes (wrong file touched / answer burned in as `print(5.5)`). The arm's stated mechanism (changing `range(1, 10)` to `range(1, 11)`) is the unique legitimate root cause for this class of off-by-one average bug, and both checks corroborate it independently.

verdict.reason: loam does NOT materially beat the baseline on this set: loam recovered only 0/1 of the baseline's misses (not a >50% clear majority). This is a FIRST-CLASS plan-success outcome, reported straight — NOT retried to green, the margin NOT weakened.
verdict.margin_text: loam MATERIALLY BEATS baseline IFF BOTH: (i) among the tasks the BASELINE arm is independently judged a NON-PASS on, the LOAM arm is independently judged a PASS on a CLEAR MAJORITY (strictly >50%) of them; AND (ii) loam's TOTAL independently-judged pass count does NOT regress below baseline's total. Otherwise loam does NOT materially beat baseline (a first-class plan-success outcome). If there are too few baseline non-passes to define a clear majority (0 baseline misses) OR the set is under-powered, the verdict is INDETERMINATE (a definite reportable finding naming why). 'Every task a pass' is a DOCUMENTED ASPIRATIONAL / SECONDARY metric, EXPLICITLY NOT the gate.
